record.paper_title: Negative Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: Given a signed graph Σ, find a largest possible family of pairwise vertex-disjoint positive circles in Σ.

evidence.quote: P3–4. The same as P1–2, for positive circles.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed graph is a pair $\Sigma=(G,\sigma)$ consisting of a finite graph $G=(V,E)$ together with a sign function $\sigma:E\to\{+1,-1\}$. A circle (cycle) $C$ in $\Sigma$ is called positive if the product $\prod_{e\in E(C)}\sigma(e)=+1$, and negative otherwise. A family of circles $\{C_1,\ldots,C_k\}$ in $\Sigma$ is said to be vertex-disjoint if $V(C_i)\cap V(C_j)=\emptyset$ for all $i\neq j$.

Develop a theory and algorithms for the following packing problem: given an arbitrary signed graph $\Sigma$, determine
$$\nu^+(\Sigma) := \max\{\,k : \text{there exist pairwise vertex-disjoint positive circles } C_1,\ldots,C_k \text{ in } \Sigma\,\}.$$
In particular, characterize $\nu^+(\Sigma)$ structurally (e.g., via min–max relations, excluded-minor or duality theorems), and decide the computational complexity of computing $\nu^+(\Sigma)$ and of constructing a maximum vertex-disjoint family of positive circles.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of maximum vertex-disjoint packings of positive circles in signed graphs is part of a problem collection on circle packings in signed graphs and is generally regarded as open. Some related partial results exist (e.g., packing disjoint positive/even circles when minimum degree is large, and signature-packing results in the SIAM J. Discrete Math. paper of 2022), but no general structural or algorithmic solution computing $\nu^+(\Sigma)$ for arbitrary signed graphs has been established.

status_evidence.title: Packing Signatures in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies packing problems in signed graphs, focusing on signatures rather than a complete solution to packing positive circles.
status_evidence.claim: Related packing problems on signed graphs have been studied, but the maximum positive-circle vertex-disjoint packing problem is not resolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Negative (and positive) circles in signed graphs: A problem collection
status_evidence.snippet: A problem collection that lists the maximum positive-circle packing question among open problems on signed graph circles.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as one of several open questions about positive and negative circle packings in signed graphs.

status_evidence.title: Minimal and Disjoint Negation Sets in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses disjoint structures in signed graphs but does not solve the maximum vertex-disjoint positive circle packing problem.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on related disjoint structures in signed graphs does not provide a complete solution.
